bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
test -d /mnt/g/GserverStorage/public_channel_videos/1877875443
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active
python3 scripts/userbot_test_client.py health
for unit in gace-public-video-all-joined-retry-20261114.service gace-public-video-all-joined-20261114.service;do
 state="$(systemctl --user show "$unit" -p ActiveState --value 2>/dev/null || echo not_loaded)"
 echo "UNAUTHORIZED=$unit:$state"
 test "$state" != active
 test "$state" != activating
done
for unit in gace-public-video-only-nippon-20261114.service gace-public-video-collect-retry-20261114.service gace-public-video-only-nippon-20261115.service;do
 state="$(systemctl --user show "$unit" -p ActiveState --value 2>/dev/null || echo not_loaded)"
 echo "PREVIOUS=$unit:$state"
 test "$state" != active
 test "$state" != activating
done
systemd-run --user --collect --unit=gace-public-video-only-nippon-20261115 --working-directory="$PWD" /usr/bin/python3 -u scripts/userbot_public_video_archive.py --channel-username theGreatOldDaysofNipponGV --all
printf 'TARGET_ARCHIVE_UNIT\n'
systemctl --user show gace-public-video-only-nippon-20261115.service -p ActiveState -p SubState -p Result -p MainPID --no-pager
echo TARGET_SCOPE_USERNAME=theGreatOldDaysofNipponGV
echo TARGET_SCOPE_CHANNEL_ID=1877875443
echo ALL_CHANNEL_JOBS_NOT_STARTED=YES
